sites.downstream: Full structured recipe object (name, ingredients[], steps[]) JSON-printed to stdout; usage and finishReason logged separately
sites.reason: Every substantive output field is free-form creative content (recipe name, ingredient names/amounts, cooking steps). Structured JSON envelope does not make it a decision. Jev primitives (Choice, Score, Noul) cannot produce recipe prose. No decomposition yields a closed-set decision component.

options.benefit: No speculative savings; the workflow is purely generative and Jev cannot produce equivalent output. Preserves correctness.
